name: sql-on-fhir-js
description: Reference implementation, test suite and test report site for the SQL on FHIR v2.0 specification

scripts.test: cd sof-js && bun test && cd .. && bun run bench:test
scripts.validate: cd sof-js && bun run validate && cd .. && bun run bench:validate
scripts.check-fmt: cd sof-js && bun run check-fmt && cd .. && bun run bench:check-fmt
scripts.build:report: cd test_report && bun run prepare && bun run build

author: John Grimes
